extraction.text:
Meenal Dixit

Mobile: +91 9611217811| Address: Noida (India)

E-Mail: Meenaldixit12@gmail.com | LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/in/meenal-dixit

Detail-oriented Data Governance and Privacy Professional with over 6 years of experience specializing in enterprise data risk mitigation, regulatory compliance frameworks, and asset lifecycle management. Proven track record in designing data risk scorecards, identifying and tagging Critical Data Elements (CDEs), and establishing clear data ownership and data sharing boundaries. Adept at managing metadata and data quality metrics across enterprise platforms to minimize risk and accelerate data privacy maturity.

Data Governance & Privacy Metadata Management, Data Stewardship, Data Risk Identification, Data Lineage Mapping, Business Glossary Curation, Data Privacy Frameworks, Data Minimization, Retention & Deletion Schedules, Business Glossary Curation. BI Tools Tableau, Power BI, MS Excel, SQL, Power Query Other Tools Solidatus, Omni, Compass, Collibra, Jira, Confluence, MS Word, MS PowerPoint. Frameworks & Compliance ERISA, IRS Regulations, Risk Reporting Standards (RRS), Record Management Standards.

Data Governance: Senior Analyst, TIAA	August 2023-October 2025

Worked with the Data Governance team to institutionalize data auditing, record management, and risk mitigation across

business domains. Spearheaded the transition of raw datasets into governed, metadata-enriched data products while building continuous control automation to support enterprise governance benchmarks.

Designed and spearheaded a quarterly Data Risk Scorecard program measuring KPIs around key metrics: Data Ownership, Data Privacy, Data Access, Data Sharing, and Data Retention.

Collaborated with business units to identify and tag Critical Data Elements (CDEs) within Collibr

Mapped technical database structures to business glossaries to ensure a single source of truth for data quality.

Managed the structural setup of the Collibra environment, defining how communities, domains, and asset types mapped back to business units.

Oversaw user role assignments and governance permissions to ensure appropriate data stewardship and asset security.

Led interactive demos with business unit heads to validate data mappings, resolve data ownership ambiguity, and enforce stewardship standards across the platform.

Defined and assigned explicit data roles (Data Owners, System Owners, Risk Stewards) in Collibra, eliminating role ambiguity and securing user access permissions.

Designed and spearheaded a quarterly Data Risk Scorecard program measuring key performance indicators (KPIs) to quantify and mitigate data handling risks across multiple business units.

Defined and assigned explicit data ownership roles (Data Owners, System Owners, and Risk Stewards) within Collibra, eliminating ambiguity regarding who was responsible for validating scorecard metrics

Stewardship & Business Glossary: Built and maintained a centralized repository and Business Glossary within Collibra, linking physical technical assets to business definitions and data quality rules.

Spearheaded data profiling initiatives to identify and resolve systemic duplication issues across enterprise business glossaries, consolidating redundant definitions to ensure a single source of truth.

Retirement Financial Analyst, TIAA	Feb 2020 - July 2023

Worked within the Institutional Retirement division to proactively manage fiduciary, financial, and operational risks across major product suites (TPA, IPRO, ATRA). Executed complex systematic distributions, financial calculations, and market alignment reconciliations under strict regulatory oversight.

Risk & Compliance Management: Managed fiduciary, financial, and operational risks within the Institutional Retirement division across major product suites (TPA, IPRO, ATRA) under strict regulatory oversight.

Data Auditing & Regulatory Adherence: Audited high-value transaction data structures and annuity

Remediation & Analysis: Engineered sophisticated gain/loss calculations and reversals for missed trade dates to restore participant accounts to their correct fiduciary states.

Microsoft Certified Power BI Data Analyst DAMA International Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP AIGPE Lean Six Sigma Green Belt DPDPA.COM Digital personal data protection Office Master Excel using AI

Degree Specialization Marks College/University Post Graduate Diploma in Mgmt. Finance 78 % Lexicon Mgmt. Institute of Leadership & Excellence Bachelor of Business Administration Finance & Marketing 9.0 CGPA Chandigarh University.

Date of Birth: 12th March 1997

Gender: Female

Languages known: English, Hindi

Passions: Dance & Music, Badminton, Social Work
